notes.title: Orbital Defense Force Available Now!
notes.content:
Orbital Defense Force is now available to purchase!


It’s hard to believe I’ve been working on this game for the past 3 and a half years. To everyone who has been following, Thanks.  It’s been a long journey and I hope Orbital Defense Force is as fun for you as it is for me.  I set out to make the game I wished was created and I’m proud of how it turned out. 


Again, thanks for all the support. It means the world.


P.S. Adding the steam launch option ‘  --morePlayers  ‘  allows lobbies of up to 8, though I’m not sure how performant or balanced that is. 


Have fun!
